Definition: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Baalah is the name of three places — the town on Judah's border where the ark was fetched from Kirjath-jearim, the town on the same border toward the sea, and the town in the south of Judah's inheritance. David went to Baalah, to Kirjath-jearim, to bring up the ark of God, and the same town is named in the border lists of Joshua twice over.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Baalah matters because the ark rested there, and David went there to bring it home. A border town became a holy place because God's presence had lodged there.
